query: Proper Ink The quill refuses the school ink. It blots, it sulks, it writes "no" in large letters. The stationer in the village has proper ink, black as a well and priced like it. Buy the proper ink The quill drinks the new ink and writes a whole page of your notes, neatly, in a better hand than yours. It underlines the bits you'll need. You feel slightly managed. Make it use the school ink It uses the school ink under protest and blots every third word, including, pointedly, your name.

results.title: How's My Quill?
results.excerpt:
How's My Quill?
"How's my quill?" says Nessa, reading over your shoulder. On Tuesday the spare quill announced the engagement of two of the gargoyles and slipped it into a proof. "You took it home half a year ago. Have you tamed it yet, or has it tamed you?"
"I'm working on it."

The Self-Writing Quill
You've enchanted a quill to take dictation. It works beautifully. A thought occurs: what if it wrote your essays, too?

Your notes are flawless. Even the professor's jokes are transcribed, with a small marginal comment: "(not funny)."
